title: Kings Escape 40 Portable 12V Camping Fridge $149 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ 4WD Supa Centre
body:
Deal: Kings Escape 40 Portable 12V Camping Fridge $149 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ 4WD Supa Centre

[StingyShopper] They are pretty good. But without a cover it defrosts in minutes in a car
[Slippery Fish] Came here to say get the cover. Definitely needs it
[3dprintdeals] What's the value method for powering these during car camping?
[bargaino] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/975146
[Mortin] I have the Kings 100Ah Lithium battery, it is save to leave it in rear floor of a sedan in the summer?
[bargaino] As long as you keep the battery inside the fridge, it will be OK.
[dylan345] Avoid leaving batteries in cars. I've seen way too many car fires started by a battery left in cars, even small ones.
[whyisave] This 40-Litre size fits snugly in the boot of a Tesla Model Y.
[Nalar] It does not fit in the boot of a 3. Have to go 30L
[Selelvian] That's surprising - I have the 40L and it fits in the boot of a Yaris
[Sheppy] The 40L is perfect for the Model Y. The floor won’t be flat tho because the 40L is too tall, so it’ll raise up by a couple inches, which is actually great for airflow.
I originally got the 30L but since the floor completely covers the bottom section, I don’t think there’ll be enough airflow so I exchanged it for the 40L.
[thedavemiester] Turn it into a kegerator. https://youtu.be/pYI_bcy_E78?si=ZvoKYCbin0OcYy6Z
[sh4hp] Is this good for keeping food chilled if unpowered?
[Black Feed Dog] i keep it in my bedroom, official external cover around bottom but top unzipped, goes from 3 at midnight to 8-10 in the afternoon, at moderate weather right now. in summer will get worse. reversible plastic cover is not air tight enough, no insulation material, not a good replacement for household fridge
[whyisave] Where did you get your 240v adapter from?
[Black Feed Dog] $180 for the entire set at some point around eofy, 24 hr rotating discounts around discount seasons.
all these fridges use same plug type with very limited power input since its designed for dc, ebay/aliexpress will work fine id guess
